facts.fact: Minister Baryomunsi told Parliament NIRA is carrying out a synchronisation process with the Uganda Communications Commission to authenticate the new national identification cards, which are not yet harmonised.

UGA.note: Nothing stated on links between civil register and ID.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing stated on numbers at birth.
Nothing stated on who operates or owns the system.

facts.fact: State Minister for Finance Amos Lugoloobi tabled a proposal before Parliament to adopt national identification numbers as the primary tax identification numbers for individuals.
The document says newly issued national ID cards are in the hands of citizens, an MP presenting his newly acquired national ID at a bank.
NIRA is synchronising with the Uganda Communications Commission to authenticate new national ID cards, after an MP said his bank refused his new ID and required a NIRA letter to verify it.

UGA.note: Nothing stated on civil registration offices.
Only a tabled proposal to use NINs as TINs, not a delivered link; no register state stated.
